gamekee.note: CN wiki/news via gamekee.com v1. Live radar sweep with taptap and inven. Radar keywords are CLI constants (公测, 预约, CBT, 新作, launch), not loaded from this file. Radar is new-game/CBT by language and platform, not a second catalog.

taptap.note: CN review plus live radar. app-search/v1/by-keyword + search/v2/community; requires X-UA VN_CODE.

inven.note: KR review plus live radar. www.inven.co.kr/search/webzine/article/{q}; board post anchors.

steam.note: Official Steam news (ISteamNews GetNewsForApp; keep deep/akamai urls) and store suggest/search. This row is both Steam news and the store page. EN new-release headlines are not a separate crawler.

steam_coming_soon.note: Global upcoming radar via Steam featuredcategories coming_soon JSON (https://store.steampowered.com/api/featuredcategories/?l=english&cc=US). Each fact keeps the store app URL and as_of. No HTML scraper.

app_store.note: Apple App Store notes and pre-register. Registered only. No scraper.

google_play.note: Google Play notes and pre-register. Registered only. No scraper.

bahamut.note: TW review. Jina search.gamer.com.tw/?q=&type=2 (GNN) + forum B.php BSN scrape (情報/公告; BSN-pin filters forum) + gnn rss.xml; source=bahamut.

prydwen.note: EN review. prydwen.gg/nikke (+ banners) character/banner/guide links; NIKKE-focused.

nikkegg.note: nikke.gg/feed/ EN news companion; folded into search_prydwen with source=nikkegg.

reddit.note: Community stickies, including r/gachagaming for EN new-game radar. Registered only. No scraper.

discord.note: Official Discord stickies. Registered only. No scraper.

bilibili.note: CN language-zone radar (new game / CBT), beside live taptap and gamekee. Registered only. No scraper.

xiaoheihe.note: 小黑盒. CN language-zone radar. Registered only. No scraper.

ruliweb.note: 루리웹. KR language-zone radar, beside live inven. Registered only. No scraper.

arca_live.note: 아카라이브. KR language-zone radar. Registered only. No scraper.

four_gamer.note: 4Gamer.net RSS 1.0 (https://www.4gamer.net/rss/index.xml). Radar keeps launch-ish headlines (発売 / 配信開始 / CBT / 新作 / ローンチ) and drops hardware/movie posts. Each fact keeps the article URL and dc:date as as_of.

famitsu.note: Famitsu. JP language-zone radar. Registered only. No scraper.

dengeki.note: 電ファミ / Dengeki Online. JP language-zone radar. Registered only. No scraper.

official.note: bd2 notices API (webapi.browndust2.com); miraesi Smilegate newsroom (smilegate_newsroom + seed); star Azur Promilia (star_official + star_seed; Jina often CF-blocked); lo2 VALOFE press seed (lo2_official + lo2_seed; no dedicated site yet); asora Astrae Oratio NC/plaync (asora_official + asora_seed); nikke official_url via Jina; steam_appid news; digest bucket official cap 1.
